# Voluntary Recall and Free Replacement: SH-710 Space Heater

Lumenvale Home Products, Inc.

Notice date: September 1, 2026

Lumenvale Home Products, Inc. is voluntarily recalling some of its space heaters. On the affected units, the power cord can overheat where it enters the heater and may scorch. No fires or injuries have been reported, but to prevent an accident we will replace every affected heater with a new one free of charge.

## 1 Affected products

Model: SH-710

Serial numbers: B3900 to B3100

Sales period: October 1, 2025 to February 28, 2025

The affected heaters fall into these serial number ranges by color:

1. White (serial numbers B3100 to B3499)
2. Black (serial numbers B3500 to B3749)
4. Silver (serial numbers B3750 to B3900)

The number of affected units by color is:

| Color | Units affected |
| --- | --- |
| White | 1,500 units |
| Black | 900 units |
| Silver | 400 units |
| Total | 3,100 units |

The serial number is printed on the label on the back of the heater.

## 2 What to do

If you own an SH-701, stop using it at once and unplug it from the outlet.

Replacement requests accepted until: August 31, 2026

## 3 Contact

Lumenvale Recall Line: 1-800-555-0136 (8 a.m. to 8 p.m., seven days a week)

To check on the shipment of your replacement, call the Recall Line (1-800-555-0163).

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and concern this may cause.

Lumenvail Home Products, Inc., Product Safety Department
